name: Vegetable Baozi
steps: Knead flour, yeast, sugar and warm water into smooth dough; cover and rise about 60 minutes until doubled.
Soak shiitake in hot water 20 minutes, squeeze dry and chop.
Finely chop cabbage, salt it and squeeze dry. Stir-fry mushrooms and carrot in neutral oil for 3 minutes; cool, then mix with cabbage, spring onion, soy sauce and sesame oil.

Divide dough into 12, roll small circles with thinner edges, fill and pleat closed. Rest 15 minutes on parchment; steam over briskly simmering water for 15 minutes, then stand covered 3 minutes before opening.
tips: A dry, cooled filling prevents soggy buns; leave space between buns as they expand in steam.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
